notes.title: Veridian Expanse on the web
notes.notes:
Veridian Expanse finally has a [url=https://veridianexpanse.com/]website[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42948394/62991b5611c44324ff3e08da7b55dafb5d0bf8b9.jpg[/img]

Ironically the website's system requirements are considerably higher than the actual game's minimum system requirements. One of the joys of writing a game without a giant off-the-shelf engine. 😁

You can also find us on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/veridian-expanse.bsky.social]🦋 Bsky[/url] and [url=https://fosstodon.org/@vexpanse]🐘 Mastodon[/url]. (Technically also on [url=https://www.threads.net/@veridianexpanse]Threads[/url], but that site doesn't feel like a great fit for a game's account.)
